title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_meisjesherinneringen_by_annie_ernaux_xpnqe (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_meisjesherinneringen_by_annie_ernaux_xpnqe' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but complete remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device.
